formation_principles: Habits emerge from repeated actual behavior rather than being selected as perks.
A routine may involve time, place, activity and recurring participants.
Irregular but meaningful patterns may remain preferences rather than habits.
A habit becomes more stable through repeated continuity, not one isolated action.
rules: Disruption does not instantly delete a habit.
A broken routine may decay over time or be replaced by a new pattern.
Recurring participants may make a social routine emotionally meaningful.
The player is never forced to resume a habit.
NPC dialogue may recognize established routines only when the NPC plausibly knows them.
